path_base: This folder; paths are relative to the folder containing this index.
import_rules: Use the listed PNGs in numerical frame order. Folder contents include historical files that are not in the current animation registrations.
Use each action frame_count; accepted cycles vary by creature and direction.
When mirror_horizontal is true, use the listed source PNGs and reflect horizontally once.
Frames retain their complete source canvas and alpha; do not trim or independently resize frames within a cycle.
Boss movement PNGs are 2D animation assets; existing materials, meshes or rigs require separate game integration.

'stoop' (front view only): two frames, the first once on entering the pose and the second held until it ends; they are a later delivery, packed onto their own atlas page by tools/add_reviewed_frames.py.

umr_at_tawil: drawn again whole by the author and put in place of the old frames (tools/replace_reviewed_sprite.py); its right view is drawn, not mirrored from its left, its four frames on a shelf at the foot of its page.

front/stoop_mid: a later delivery, packed onto its own atlas page by tools/add_reviewed_frames.py; the frames of an action play in order on the canvas and ground line of their view's idle (the stoop's: once, the last held).

back/attack, back/hurt, left/attack, left/hurt: a later delivery, packed onto its own atlas page by tools/add_reviewed_frames.py; the frames of an action play in order on the canvas and ground line of their view's idle (the stoop's: once, the last held).

back/flight, front/flight, left/flight, right/flight: a later delivery, packed onto its own atlas page by tools/add_reviewed_frames.py; the frames of an action play in order on the canvas and ground line of their view's idle (the stoop's: once, the last held).
